Name: Kxgarashii's Yandere Portraits
Author: Kxgarashii
Description:
[b]CONTENT PATCHER INSTALLATION
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have all the required mods in your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder [b](Download [/b][b]PyTK, NOT PyTK Lite)[/b]
[*]Extract the mod into your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
[*]To choose your preferred portrait, open the config.json and change the option you prefer. (ex: one, two, three)
[*]You can pick and choose which portraits you want by toggling the character to false in the config.
[/list][b]
PORTRAITURE INSTALLATION [/b]

[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have all the required mods in your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
[*]Go to Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits and create a folder to put the png files into
[*]Rename your preferred portrait name to Name.png. (ex: Alex Ver 2.png → Alex.png)
[*]Press p during in-game dialogue to switch the portraits.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Contains portraits with custom expressions. Requires a supporting mod to work. This file is only for reference.
SMAPI, Content Patcher, and PyTK (not PyTK Lite) are required
